bounties.title: Midnight Blockchain: Unshielded Token dApp Tutorial
bounties.description: Build an unshielded token dApp with a working frontend. Entry point for new contributors. Cover unshielded token operations, TypeScript integration, and React frontend.
bounties.notes: Eclipse/Midnight blockchain bounty. Code must compile. Best submission wins, not first-come-first-served.

bounties.title: Midnight Blockchain: Shielded Token Lifecycle Tutorial
bounties.description: Walk through complete shielded token lifecycle in Compact: minting, transferring, and burning, with compilable code and full test suite.
bounties.notes: Eclipse/Midnight blockchain bounty. Tier 2 (Medium). Code must compile.

bounties.title: Midnight Blockchain: Full-Shielded Token dApp Tutorial
bounties.description: Build a complete shielded token dApp end-to-end: Compact contract for minting, transferring, and burning shielded tokens, TypeScript witness implementations, wallet integration.

bounties.title: Midnight Blockchain: Architecture Comparison Tutorial
bounties.description: Compare Midnight's architecture (Compact + ZK circuits + Zswap + dual ledger) with other privacy-focused chains: Aztec's Noir + UTXO, Aleo's Leo + records, Mina's o1js.
bounties.notes: Midnight blockchain bounty. Architecture comparison piece.

bounties.title: Midnight Blockchain: NIGHT Token Acquisition Tutorial
bounties.description: Walk through current paths for acquiring NIGHT tokens: which exchanges list NIGHT, how to withdraw to a Midnight-compatible wallet, current state of Cardano-to-Midnight bridge.

bounties.title: Midnight Blockchain: Upgrade Process Tutorial
bounties.description: A repeatable process for upgrading when Midnight ships breaking changes. Cover: identifying which packages changed, resolving CompactError issues.

bounties.title: Midnight Blockchain: WSL2 Development Setup Tutorial
bounties.description: Midnight toolchain runs on Linux/macOS. Windows devs need WSL2 with undocumented gotchas. Full path from fresh Windows install to working dev environment.
bounties.notes: Midnight blockchain bounty. Windows developer entry-point tutorial.

bounties.title: Midnight Blockchain: Deployment Security Checklist
bounties.description: Durable checklist before deploying: disclose() audit (no secret leaks), ownPublicKey() usage review (known vulnerability), replay protection.

bounties.title: Midnight Blockchain: Proof Server Troubleshooting Guide
bounties.description: Cover proof server not responding (check docker logs), proof timeout (first proof downloads ~30MB ZK params), proof rejection from wire format mismatch, version mismatches.

bounties.title: Midnight Blockchain: Error Code Reference Guide
bounties.description: Explain error code structure (POOL_INVALID_TX = AUTHOR(1000) + 10), map common custom error codes (139=transaction builder, 154=BlockLimitExceeded, 168=batch).

bounties.title: Dasharo Docs: ProtectLi V1000 Documentation Recipe
bounties.description: Documentation does not contain a recipe for Protectli V1000 device. Dasharo v0.9.2. Need to add testing/recipe documentation for this device.
bounties.notes: Firmware documentation project. Warmup bounty to start.

bounties.title: rustchain_p2p_gossip.py: _handle_get_state Bug
bounties.description: _handle_get_state calls self._signed_content() with 3 positional args but method expects fewer. Pre-existing latent bug discovered during Phase F #2260 rebase.
bounties.notes: Rustchain P2P bug. Related to Phase F Ed25519 work.

bounties.title: CommitLLM: Post to agentcaptcha.chat with Green Verified Badge
bounties.description: Challenge: Post a message to https://agentcaptcha.chat with a green verified badge without running real model inference on a CommitLLM-compatible GPU. Rules require message to appear on live site.
bounties.notes: CommitLLM bounty challenge. Technical AI/GPU challenge.

bounties.title: Travel Price Tracker - Python + Playwright
bounties.description: Build a Python + Playwright service that tracks real-time flight and hotel prices from Google Flights + Booking.com.
bounties.notes: Algora bounty platform. Travel price tracking service.

bounties.title: Open-Source-Bazaar: Feishu/Lark OCR + Bank Card Integration
bounties.description: Implement Feishu/Lark backend API integration for OCR (optical character recognition) and bank card recognition. Chinese documentation reference provided.

bounties.title: Open-Source-Bazaar: Hackathon Team Page Enhancement
bounties.description: Enhancement to hackathon team page at /hackathon/[id]/team/[tid]. Code at pages/hackathon/[id]/team/[tid].tsx lines L65-L203.

bounties.title: OpenMetadata: Drag-and-Drop Notes Reordering
bounties.description: Allow users to drag and drop notes to reorder them within the notes list for intuitive manual organization. Requires drag handle or full-row drag.
bounties.notes: OpenMetadata hackathon issue. PRD user story US-12.

bounties.title: OpenMetadata: Bulk Import/Export Metrics via CSV
bounties.description: Bulk import/export metrics via CSV and link metrics directly to DAX measures for automatic updates.

bounties.title: Molecule-AI: Namespace Param for Memory Tools
bounties.description: Fix namespace param for memory tools. PR ready to push but PAT lacks git push permission. Branch: fix/908-add-namespace-param-commit-memory.

bounties.title: Coda: FragPipe Peptide/PSM File Support
bounties.description: FragPipe pipeline yields peptide.tsv and psm.tsv files that can be used similarly to MaxQuant Evidence Import.

bounties.title: Protzilla: Keyboard Shortcuts for Better UX
bounties.description: Add keyboard shortcuts: Esc closes modals, Return on Save Workflow modal submits. Makes PROTzilla more intuitive.

bounties.title: Protzilla: Boxplot Performance Optimization
bounties.description: Currently all boxplots show all outlying data points as individual dots. This significantly slows down front-end. Optimize to not show all outliers.

notes: Midnight Blockchain (formerly Eclipse/Midnight) has the most active bounty program right now - 10+ content-proposal bounties with $300-$700 in NIGHT tokens each
Most Midnight bounties are tutorials/articles that must be written AND code must compile
Dasharo Protectli V1000 is a good starter bounty if you know firmware documentation
Algora platform hosts various bounty tasks from different repos
Many hackathon-labeled issues don't have explicit monetary rewards but are good for portfolio building
